competency.title: Design continual backprop — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for continual backprop using a selective dormant-unit reset trial. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a selective dormant-unit reset trial.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report plasticity recovery and retained skills with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: resetting useful weights without rollback.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of continual backprop.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report plasticity recovery and retained skills against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for resetting useful weights without rollback; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
